title: CORS preflight blocked for supplier profile update endpoint
description: Updating supplier profile fails from browser clients in production. Preflight OPTIONS request is rejected because the PATCH method is not included in allowed CORS methods.
steps_to_reproduce: Open supplier profile page in production
Observe network error and blocked CORS preflight
error_log: Access to fetch at 'https://api.marketconnect.com/supplier/profile' from origin 'https://app.marketconnect.com' has been blocked by CORS policy: Method PATCH is not allowed by Access-Control-Allow-Methods
expected_behavior: PATCH request is allowed and supplier profile updates successfully
actual_behavior: Browser blocks request during preflight due to CORS method mismatch
recent_changes: Security hardening updated CORS config to explicit allowed methods list
